label: PF Backlog 621
title: Harden auto-loaded config against schema mixing + tooling writes outside the repo (residency-profiles vs residency-cells)
body: RCCA (BI-PF-1303): a tool call used relative '..\..\' paths that resolved OUTSIDE the repo (a dev key + region-cells could have been written to a stray folder). Separately, residency.LoadDir loads every *.json in the policy dir as a policy, so region-cell/keyring JSON placed there was mis-parsed. Fix (done in 1303): separate config/residency-profiles (policies) from config/residency-cells (cells+keyring); LoadDir now fails loudly naming a non-policy file. This item tracks the GENERAL guard: one-schema-per-dir + no tooling writes outside the repo (IS-PF-0036 family).

objective: Make schema-mixing in auto-loaded dirs and out-of-repo tooling writes fail loudly, repo-wide.
acceptance_criteria: An auto-loaded config directory (e.g. residency policy profiles) that contains a NON-conforming JSON file fails loudly, naming the offending file, instead of silently mis-parsing it as the wrong schema.
Tooling/scripts that write files cannot write outside the repository/worktree: a relative path traversal (..\..) is rejected/flagged, never silently resolved into a different folder.
approach: Extend the store/diff guard (wired_audit) to flag writes that escape the repo, and document one-schema-per-dir for auto-loaded config; residency already fails loudly (done in 1303).
verification: pending: a wired_audit check + a test

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/schema_validator.py with a per-dir schema manifest (one expected schema per config dir) and a repo-root containment check; extend core/port_config.py LoadDir to use it. Add path guard util in core/repo_setup.py validating resolved write targets stay under repo root. Reuse existing QA gates in core/qa_report.py.
